_meta_nav_six_clusters_note: nav-six-clusters (2026-08-20, design.md §4 row 7): InventoryValuations was a near-identical duplicate INDEX of the base manifest's InventoryValuation (same schema, no distinguishing filter) — deleted along with its menu leaf; InventoryValuation is canonical. InventoryValuationDetail is KEPT here unchanged: it already shadows/wins over a dead duplicate declaration of the same id in the base manifest (removed separately) — the effective detail route stays /inventory/valuations/:id exactly as served today, per REQ-NAVC-010 (no route renames).

config._note: VALUATION snapshot (the FIFO/AVG value of a product's stock at a warehouse on a date — the number that lands on the balance sheet and feeds COGS). The body foregrounds the valuation maths: quantity × unit cost = total value, the method that produced it, the date, warehouse, product and cost-center it books to, and the pending-COGS flag. A leaf snapshot with no child lines; no comms. The audit trail sidebar is the recalculation/method-change record, essential when a valuation is restated.
